beliefs: The first character is shifted backward by 2 in the alphabet (a->y, b->z, ..., z->x; A->Y, ..., Z->X) [E7, E8, E9, E10]
All characters after the first are left unchanged, including letters, digits, spaces, and symbols [E1, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8]
If the first character is not an ASCII letter (digit, space, symbol, control char), it is left unchanged [E1, E11]
Non-ASCII accented letters are also shifted backward by 2 within their own case block (é->ç, É->Ç, ü->ú, ß->Ý, ñ->ï) [E11]
notes: E11 shows non-ASCII accented letters are shifted by 2 within their Unicode case block, not left unchanged; I added a fallback that shifts any alphabetic first char backward by 2 within its case, keeping ASCII behavior identical so E1-E10 still match.
